name: states
title: States
description: Named values your setup can react to: the ones you declare, built-ins like the hour, the front app and the network, and what extensions publish. Set one by hand for a while, reset it, or declare a new one.
author: pal

store.tagline: See, set and declare the named states your setup reacts to
features: Every state with its live value and where it comes from: set by hand, its expression, an extension, the default
Hold one true or false for 15 minutes, an hour, three hours or until tomorrow, or type any value and duration
New state adds one to your config file with an expression, a default and a description
A bar item that shows while a state is held by hand, with the time left

screenshots.caption: Every state with its value and which layer answers: its expression, set by hand with the time left, a publisher, built-in
Tab steps through the filters: held by hand, yours, what extensions publish, the built-ins
Set a state for an hour, three, until tomorrow or a value typed, reset it, or remove it from the config
New state writes [states.<name>] to the config: a name, an expression over the others, a default
On the menu bar only while a state is held by hand: its name and the time left
Two held: the soonest to run out first, the count after it
A click opens the palette: every state with its value; Enter flips one, ⌘R resets it
On sketchybar: the state and the time left on amber
